The four 0U/0D to 1L or same-height far vertex (0U-1U,0D-1D) remain outside both interiors. The remaining cross pairs 0U-1D and 0D-1U enter the right triangle. Thus exactly four are legal. The three dashed guides are candidate joins, and their crossing behavior is plainly visible; no join is labelled valid.
